verdict.rationale: Epic documents official command-line surfaces. These include headless commandlets invoked via `UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...` and the Unreal Automation Tool for scripted build, cook, package, deploy and test. The editor executable also has a documented command-line-argument reference, and these docs are fetchable keylessly by agents. However, the CLI is fragmented across the editor executable, UAT and UBT rather than offered as a single purpose-built tool, and nothing shows it is shaped for agent use. missing for 10: a unified dedicated CLI, documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output or agent-oriented ergonomics, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI-driven workflows.
